report.headline: A region enters an administered price period when the cumulative uncapped spot or ancillary service prices over the prior seven days exceed the cumulative price threshold.

document_statements.quote: Under clause 3.14.2(c) of the NER, an administered price period for a region is triggered if: (a) The sum of the uncapped spot prices or ancillary service prices for that region over the previous 2016 trading intervals (7 days) exceeds the cumulative price threshold; or (b) Refer to 15.2.
An administered price period is determined to apply separately for each region.
Once an administered price period is declared for a region, the remaining trading intervals for that trading day will also be administered price periods.

If the sum of the uncapped spot prices in a region has triggered an administered price period, then from the next trading interval: (a) If the spot price exceeds the APC, then AEMO must set the spot price to the APC. (b) If the spot price is less than the administered floor price, AEMO must set the spot price to the administered floor price. (c) If an ancillary service price for any market ancillary services in that region exceeds the APC, AEMO will set that ancillary service price to the APC.

citations.supports: Defines the primary trigger for an administered price period (sum of uncapped spot or ancillary service prices over prior 2016 trading intervals exceeding the cumulative price threshold).

citations.quote: An administered price period is determined to apply separately for each region.
citations.supports: States that administered price periods are determined on a per-region basis.

citations.quote: Once an administered price period is declared for a region, the remaining trading intervals for that trading day will also be administered price periods.
citations.supports: Explains that declaration applies to the rest of the trading day for that region.

citations.quote: If the sum of the uncapped spot prices in a region has triggered an administered price period, then from the next trading interval: (a) If the spot price exceeds the APC, then AEMO must set the spot price to the APC. (b) If the spot price is less than the administered floor price, AEMO must set the spot price to the administered floor price. (c) If an ancillary service price for any market ancillary services in that region exceeds the APC, AEMO will set that ancillary service price to the APC.
citations.supports: Describes how AEMO applies administered price cap and floor to spot and ancillary service prices once an administered price period is triggered.
